snippet.title: THEC64 Mini Black Edition (PEGI)
snippet.description: This stunning new *Black Edition* of the best-selling *THEC64 Mini* has been beautifully reimagined in a bold matte-and-gloss black finish, making it a striking, collectible redesign of the beloved 8-bit machine.  Along with the sleek aesthetic, *THEC64 Mini – Black Edition* arrives with 25 hand-picked pre-installed Neo-Classic retro games, all among the highest rated C64 titles and many of which have been enhanced for this release and are otherwise commercially unavailable.
